page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8163 processors clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 372.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.88 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and compute acceleration are delivered via four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs, providing a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies entirely on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.2 GB/sec. Conversely, the instance performs strongly in parallelized workloads, achieving a multi-core stress-ng score of 70574.45 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 287.37 GB/sec. Memory performance is highly efficient for cached operations, with a read-only small block bandwidth of 3924.63 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write speeds remain average at 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec respectively. The instance also demonstrates high efficiency in key-value operations, processing 64.27 million Redis SET operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its reliance on older Intel Xeon architecture and Turing-generation GPUs, which limits single-threaded execution speed but offers high resource density for parallel processing. Because local storage is absent, workloads must be optimized for network-attached storage. The combination of 96 dedicated cores, 372 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA T4 GPUs makes this server highly suitable for multi-GPU deep learning inference, parallel data processing, distributed caching, and multi-threaded simulation workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for highly parallelized workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 cores at 2.5 GHz, 372.0 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs with a total of 64 GB VRAM. The instance lacks local storage but provides 30 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data indicates weak single-core performance but strong multi-core execution, highlighted by a multi-core stress-ng score of 70574.45 and 287.37 GB/sec multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Cached memory bandwidth is highly efficient at 3924.63 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations reach 64.27 million operations per second. This hardware profile is optimized for parallel processing, multi-GPU machine learning inference, distributed caching, and multi-threaded compute workloads rather than single-threaded tasks.
